meta.name: Real Men
meta.description: Four old friends, Massimo, Mattia, Luigi and Riccardo, juggle relationships, careers and dating in a modern world set on giving masculinity a hard time.

videos.title: Made in Italy
videos.overview: Massimo goes from big shot to jobless. Luigi's wife is sexually frustrated. Riccardo's partner has a proposal. Mattia's daughter is helping him date.

videos.title: Mon Amour
videos.overview: Mattia has a disastrous date while Luigi tries the little blue pill — but his efforts to rekindle his love life don't go as planned.

videos.title: Life on Holiday
videos.overview: An island getaway by boat doesn't help the four friends bond. Meanwhile, Tiziana gets dangerously closer to her gym instructor.

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: Luigi reconnects with Eugenio, an old gay friend who suggests some changes to the guys. Massimo encounters some former colleagues from his bossy past.

videos.title: Superheroes
videos.overview: A romantic break in Venice turns disastrous for Luigi. Massimo and Daniela discuss big plans. Riccardo desperately flirts after Ilenia's ultimatum.

videos.title: Loss of Love
videos.overview: Daniela's success as an influencer accelerates. Riccardo gets a voucher for a threesome. Mattia's daughter's interest in his sex life goes a bit too far.

videos.title: Everything Else Is a Bore
videos.overview: After rebelling in the workshop, Massimo starts his own course, causing tensions at home. Tiziana finds that having a younger lover has its drawbacks.

videos.title: Men Never Change
videos.overview: Massimo battles with his partner online and Luigi gets competitive over his son's party. Apparently, the real men of Rome are back on top — but are they?
